deck.ko: 꽃 한 송이를 더 고르는 사이, 퀼팅 아래로 체크가 살짝 보이는 차림.
deck.en: Choosing one more stem, with a flash of check under the quilting.
deck.de: Noch ein Stiel dazu – unter dem Stepp blitzt das Karo hervor.

intro.ko: 꽃집 앞에서 꽃다발을 품에 안은 채 한 송이를 더 고릅니다. 짧은 퀼팅 재킷 아래로 체크 셔츠 밑단이 나와 차분한 네이비에 리듬을 줍니다.
intro.en: Bouquet in one arm, she reaches for one more stem. Below the short quilted jacket, the check shirt's hem adds rhythm to the calm navy.
intro.de: Den Strauß im Arm greift sie nach einem weiteren Stiel. Unter der kurzen Steppjacke bringt der Saum des Karohemds Rhythmus ins ruhige Marineblau.

body.ko: 크림색 파인 니트까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with cream fine knit.

tip.ko: 체크 오버셔츠를 재킷보다 조금 더 길게 두면 짧은 재킷이 더 경쾌해 보여요.
tip.en: Let the overshirt hang a little longer than the jacket; the cropped line looks livelier for it.
tip.de: Das Overshirt etwas länger als die Jacke tragen – so wirkt die kurze Linie lebendiger.

ko.deck: 네이비 크롭 퀼팅 재킷에 레드·네이비 체크 오버셔츠을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Navy cropped quilted jacket over red and navy plaid overshirt for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Kurze marineblaue Steppjacke über Rot-marineblaues Karo-Overshirt für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.
